screen_flicker_battery: Display flickering combined with rapid battery drain is commonly caused by adaptive brightness conflicting with a third-party app, or a stuck refresh-rate setting. First, open Settings > Display > Motion smoothness and set it to Standard instead of Adaptive. Second, open Settings > Battery > Background usage limits and check for apps consuming excess power. If the issue persists after 24 hours, a factory reset may be required as a last resort.
swipe_navigation_wrong: After installing a new app, swipe gesture navigation can occasionally default to scroll-style movement instead of directional swipes. Open Settings > Display > Navigation bar and confirm Swipe gestures is selected rather than Buttons. Toggle Gesture hint on to display guidance lines at the bottom of the screen for confirmation.
